Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; reviewed period printings; issue #821.

Cards.Name: The Governor's Estate
Cards.Text:
Your face-down Dynasty cards in play are Holdings with the trait, "Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold." 
Twice per turn, after your Dynasty Phase begins, you may pay 2 Gold to turn a card in your Province face-down (if needed) and put it into play bowed.
Limited: Gain 2 Honor. You may not declare an attack.
Tireless Battle: Discard a card to give a target Personality +2F or -2F.
